entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Broken promise

*For a moment, the victim remembers a pain that has not happened yet.*

**Target:** One hearing creature within 6 squares. **Player defense:** Reason. **Damage type:** mental.

**Weak defense:** Dazed 2. **Standard defense:** Dazed 1.

**Spell:** Provokes when cast beside an enemy.

entries.name: Reproach the Caster
entries.effect: After taking spell HP damage: hearing caster within 6 gains Frightened 2.
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Reproach the Caster

*A whispered accusation rides the fading spell back toward the one who shaped it.*

After a spell attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, its visible caster within 6 squares gains Frightened 2 of this creature if the caster can hear it. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. Frightened applies only while this creature is perceptible; the spell is not canceled.

details.flavorMarkdown: *A lean fiend with a too-wide mouth and a face that resembles someone the observer has disappointed. It feeds its influence through broken obligations and private bargains.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Broken promise

*For a moment, the victim remembers a pain that has not happened yet.*

**Target:** One hearing creature within 6 squares. **Player defense:** Reason. **Damage type:** mental.

**Weak defense:** Dazed 2. **Standard defense:** Dazed 1.

**Spell:** Provokes when cast beside an enemy.

### Spell Screen

Before one spell against it resolves, impose 1 Bane on that player attack (or give its controller 1 defense Boon). For one player AoE roll, include this when choosing worst-case modifiers. Does not cancel the spell.

### Reproach the Caster

*A whispered accusation rides the fading spell back toward the one who shaped it.*

After a spell attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, its visible caster within 6 squares gains Frightened 2 of this creature if the caster can hear it. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. Frightened applies only while this creature is perceptible; the spell is not canceled.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Written agreements lose a few crucial words overnight.

**Purpose:** Make people abandon the obligations holding them together.

**Tactics and retreat:** Hammer the leader’s mind, then offer a way out at someone else’s expense.

**Counterplay and conversation:** State a limited promise, fulfill it openly, and deny private bargains.

**Habitat:** Court; crossroads · **Communication:** Common and Infernal

**Loot:** Stolen contracts, a named secret and 100 coins; promises are not transferable character powers.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-oath-devourer


**Category:** Fiend · **Role:** Mental predator · **CV:** 36

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Broken promise | Guile | 1 Boon | 4 mental damage. | 6 mental damage. Dazed 1. | 9 mental damage. Dazed 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 4/6/9

**Reference type:** mental

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.6

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.5 → 1.6: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.404, O=6.951. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [mind hammer](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/mind-hammer.md), [Reproach the Caster](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/reproach-the-caster.md), [spell screen](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/spell-screen.md).

monsterAbilityTemplates.flavorMarkdown: *A sharp gesture splinters the incoming light into a cloud of harmless sparks.*
monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
Before one spell attack against this creature resolves, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll (or grant 1 defense Boon to its player controller). The protection belongs to this creature. For a player’s single AoE attack roll, include it when finding the worst target modifiers, as normal; do not make a separate roll or rescore outcomes for other targets. If players defend separately against an NPC area, it benefits only its own recipient. This is defensive interference, not cancellation; the resulting spell outcome still resolves.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

# Spell Screen

*A sharp gesture splinters the incoming light into a cloud of harmless sparks.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-spell-screen


**Action:** Reaction

Before one spell attack against this creature resolves, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll (or grant 1 defense Boon to its player controller). The protection belongs to this creature. For a player’s single AoE attack roll, include it when finding the worst target modifiers, as normal; do not make a separate roll or rescore outcomes for other targets. If players defend separately against an NPC area, it benefits only its own recipient. This is defensive interference, not cancellation; the resulting spell outcome still resolves.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
